note: Synthetic data generated to mirror the structure of HUNT's geriatric/70+ sub-study variables. Not real HUNT data; real HUNT access requires REK/HUNT Research Centre approval.
target_description: Binary outcome: clinically meaningful frailty progression / adverse outcome (severe frailty, institutionalisation-level decline, or death proxy) within a ~4-year synthetic follow-up, analogous to a HUNT4->HUNT5 linkage.

columns.municipality: Synthetic municipality in the HUNT (Trøndelag) catchment area
columns.weight_loss_kg_last_year: Self-reported unintentional weight loss, kg (Fried component)
columns.gait_speed_ms: Usual gait speed, m/s, 4m walk test (Fried component)
columns.falls_last_year: Number of falls in the past 12 months
columns.comorbidity_count: Count of the 8 comorbidity flags above
columns.fried_frailty_status_baseline: Fried phenotype category at baseline: Robust/Pre-frail/Frail
columns.frailty_index_baseline: Continuous deficit-accumulation frailty index, 0-1, at baseline
columns.future_frailty_risk: TARGET: 1 = adverse frailty outcome by follow-up, 0 = stable/robust
